title: Edit a chain by describing it
description: Describe a change to how this folder's chains, tools, prompts, settings or memory work, such as "in make-change, add a lint step before the tests". An agent edits this folder's .swarm files, swarm checks they still load, and you see the diff: approve it, or send it back with a note. If you reject it or anything fails, the files are put back. It never changes the shared library in ~/.swarm.
